description: A green flag with an off-centre red disc flies from a tall bamboo pole on a stormy, grey-skied riverbank. A crowd of villagers in saris, lungis and loose shirts look up at it, and a river beyond them is packed with wooden boats with sails and passengers. Brick and tin-roofed houses and a thin smoke plume sit on the far bank, with palm and tree silhouettes in the haze. Oil-painting texture, no visible text or frame.
